inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Thank you for confirming that the base remains dry.' after the customer said 'I haven't looked under the kick plate'

rationale: The customer stated three times that the lower spray arm is visibly cracked with water spurting from the crack, yet the assistant ignored this, misread 'spurts' as an external leak, and pivoted to irrelevant door/hose/base-tray leak checks. It then fabricated that the customer had 'confirmed the base remains dry' when she explicitly said she had not looked, and ended with an unnecessary engineer referral while refusing to confirm the obvious lower spray arm replacement. Safety advice (unplug, gloves) was fine but the conversation gave the homeowner nothing useful toward the correct part or the product-code check.
